subject.title: [Feature]: Generate and update openclaw.json JSON schema on bootstrap/update

question: Should OpenClaw accept default-on local editor-schema sidecar generation and root `$schema` stamping on OpenClaw-owned config writes, or keep schema setup explicit/manual?
rationale: Current main only supports manual schema export and existing `$schema` preservation; the requested default-on behavior changes generated config output and may add config surface, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept the proven PR shape
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89992 or an equivalent after merge refresh, preserving config writer invariants and documenting the chosen filename/default contract.

options.title: Keep manual schema export
options.body: Close this direction and continue supporting `openclaw config schema` plus docs-based editor setup without default-on config writes.

options.title: Narrow to explicit opt-in
options.body: Ask for an explicit command or opt-in workflow if default-on sidecar files are too invasive for existing config writes.

recommendation.title: Accept the proven PR shape
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89992 or an equivalent after merge refresh, preserving config writer invariants and documenting the chosen filename/default contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config writer and CLI history makes this the best available routing candidate for the compatibility/default decision.
